summary.text: Pat Marsh is the Republican state representative for Tennessee House District 62, which covers Bedford and Moore counties and part of Lincoln County, who has served since 2009 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
He is a retired trucking company owner.

paragraphs.text: Marsh was born on January 6, 1949, in Fayetteville, Tennessee, and holds a B.S. in transportation from the University of Tennessee.
The legislature's biography lists him as retired from trucking and as chairman emeritus of Big G Express, and Ballotpedia describes him as the owner of Big G Express.
He is a former president of the Shelbyville Rotary Club and has served on the boards of the Tennessee Trucking Association and the Tennessee Walking Horse National Celebration.
Marsh has been a member of the House since the 106th General Assembly and served as Speaker Pro Tempore in the 112th General Assembly.
He chairs the Ethics Committee and is a member of the Calendar & Rules, Commerce, Government Operations, Naming & Designating and Transportation committees.
Ballotpedia reports that he faces Democrat Brieanna Akers in the general election.
